title: NASA Made Atoms 0.0000000001 Kelvin—Colder Than Space
hook: NASA chilled atoms to 0.0000000001 kelvin, colder than deep space.
closing: The universe's deepest cold is now an engineering achievement.
question: What would you test there?

segments.say: Deep space is 2.7 kelvin, cold but still above absolute zero.
NASA's Cold Atom Lab reaches 0.0000000001 kelvin, colder than the Boomerang Nebula.
The ISS lab orbits about 250 miles up, placing extreme cold surprisingly close.
